description: HyperBlade-fidelity playable slice: elliptical drome, carried/thrown rok, 1/2/4-point multiplier goals, 2 forwards + AI goalie and a bench, jak attacks, speedburst, drome hazards, three periods, 14 teams/dromes reconstructed from the 1996 HyperBlade DATA/*.HTM and DATA/*.ENV, Gauntlet progression, HyperBlade HUD and stat screen, on the Unity 6 Windows player.
checks: Windows player builds with the HyperBlade systems
legacy GYPSY_DEMO_OK collected=3 and hero capture remain green
headless 3-period match scores and prints UBLADE2_MATCH_OK with a v2 evidence JSON
14 teams and 14 dromes generated from the original game data
large elliptical half-pipe drome with a 40m shell and 6m curved floor
85-degree player-tracking camera and camera-relative WASD, verified by a real-keyboard play-test
1280x720 match capture shows the half-pipe drome, goals, skaters and HUD
six UI screenshots show menu, league, settings, match HUD, pause and result/stats
notes: Original assets are not shipped; dromes/players are runtime low-poly reconstructions in the original proportions and livery logic.
Killball/swarf/mine weapon economy, bench fatigue/death bookkeeping and wall-riding tricks are approximated or not implemented; see DEFERRED and docs/GAME-DESIGN.md.
